hypothesis: With identical independent RL16 starts and training/evaluation recipe, changing only the pairwise judge changes the aesthetic and spatial qualities reinforced in heldout paintings.
primary_comparison: Same 16 heldout briefs at exactly 12 completed optimizer updates per arm; fresh RL16 control generated once under the same evaluation setup. Human side-by-side visual preference is primary; raw rewards from different judges are not interchangeable.

evaluation_common.missing_or_invalid_terminal_cases: Reported separately; no retained earlier image counted as a successful terminal action.

gpu_plan.topology: twoH10080: inference1 trainer1, same node reused sequentially
gpu_plan.estimate_limitations: Judge latency and on-policy validity may differ; an estimate, not a quote.
gpu_plan.failed_starts: counted in this campaign cap; no unbounded automatic retries

preservation: Public hash-verifiedHFcheckpoints and screened evidence, source via reviewedGitbundle.
research_scope: Actual training ablation; frozen-image judge panel is supporting evidence and not a substitute.
limitations: Equal requested reasoning effort is not equal internal compute.
Async sampling/admission may yield different accepted batches as policies and judge uncertainty diverge; identical pool and seeds do not imply identical generated trajectories.
A single run per judge and 16 heldout cases is exploratory, not a precise population-level effect estimate.
